Daiwa Sb Investments LTD Increases Holding in First Solar (FSLR); Shareholder Wharton Business Group Has Increased Apple (AAPL) Position
May 31, 2018 - By Linda Rogers
Daiwa Sb Investments Ltd increased its stake in First Solar Inc (FSLR) by 131.36% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Daiwa Sb Investments Ltd bought 7,473 shares as the company’s stock rose 4.84% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 13,162 shares of the technology company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $934,000, up from 5,689 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Daiwa Sb Investments Ltd who had been investing in First Solar Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $7.26 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.43% or $0.3 during the last trading session, reaching $69.34. About 26,914 shares traded. First Solar, Inc. (NASDAQ:FSLR) has risen 79.89% since May 31, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 67.32% the S&P500.
Wharton Business Group Llc increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 1.67% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Wharton Business Group Llc bought 2,610 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 158,507 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $26.59M, up from 155,897 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Wharton Business Group Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $921.44B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.02% or $0.03 during the last trading session, reaching $187.47. About 1.31 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since May 31, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500.
